clusters.name: Your sister Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Within about a year and a half of Bea's birth in March 1995, you said your mother was 'worn out and on edge' by August 1995, your father working late and rarely home followed by November, your own stomach aches and missing school began by February 1996, shouting matches between your father and Jonah came in May 1996, and your mother not going back to her job came by September 1996, all held together around the same new child in the house.
